headline: Two newcomers join at the back, and DeepSeek's provider share climbs to 37.3%
summary: Anthropic's claude-fable-5.1 and Google's gemma-4-26b-a4b-it debut at ranks 50 and 51, while gemini-3.7-flash and Inkling fall off the bottom. Up top, deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still holds #1 with 24.8% of tokens, and DeepSeek and Zhipu AI together account for 48.3%.
highlights: New entrants: anthropic/claude-fable-5.1-20260831 debuts at #50 with a 0.2% token share, and google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403 arrives at #51, also at 0.2%.
Dropouts: google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 (last seen at #49) and thinkingmachines/inkling-20260715:free (last seen at #51) are gone from the board.
StepFun's stepfun/step-5-preview-20261008 is the week's climber, up 15 places over seven days to #8.
openai/gpt-6.1-sol-20260929 jumped six spots in a single day to #13.
Xiaomi is sliding: mimo-v2.6-flash-20260921 dropped four places today to #17 and 13 over 30 days.
DeepSeek and Zhipu AI hold 48.3% between them, and adding OpenAI and Anthropic lifts the top four to 64.0%.
